plugin.name: Glad You're Here
plugin.description:
Hugging someone with Glad You're Here lowers your Stress and Fear stress:
Your children: -25 Your spouse or lover: -18 Good friends (confidant or ally): -10 Followers, strangers and pets: -5
You get a short "The hug eases your stress." notification when it works. Stress never goes below 0.
Needs ImGladYoureHere.esp (Glad You're Here 3.6) and Stress and Fear.esp (Stress and Fear 2.07), plus SKSE. ESL-flagged, so it uses no plugin slot. Load order doesn't matter. Safe to add to an existing save.

plugin.name: OStim
plugin.description:
Each time your character climaxes in an OStim scene, your Stress and Fear stress goes down. The amount depends on the act in the scene where you finish, plus a bonus for who your partner is:
Vaginal intercourse: -20 Anal intercourse: -15 Oral: -10 Manual and everything else: -5
Spouse or lover: a further -10 Good friend (confidant or ally): a further -5
With Fertility Mode Reloaded, a conception involving your character (either parent) lowers stress by another 10, with a neutral message so FMR's pregnancy reveal isn't spoiled.
Counts every climax. Adults only: nothing happens if a child is in the scene. Stress never goes below 0.
Needs OStim.esp (OStim Standalone 7.5c) and Stress and Fear.esp (Stress and Fear 2.07), plus SKSE. Fertility Mode Reloaded 1.0.7 is optional. ESL-flagged, so it uses no plugin slot. Load order doesn't matter. Safe to add to an existing save.
